question: Why did the error rate go up on 26 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of checkout v3.17 introduced a NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize.
why_chain: Checkout v3.17 was deployed to ap-south 2 minutes before the error rate spike.
NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize was observed in the logs 10 minutes after the deployment.
The error rate increased from 0.53% to 3.54% after the deployment.

contributing_factors.description: The error rate spike coincided with a deployment, suggesting a correlation.
why_chain: The error rate spike occurred at the same time as a deployment (checkout v3.17).
No other deployment was noted in the same region at the same time.
The error rate spike was not preceded by any other known changes or anomalies.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: No configuration change was noted in the evidence.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: No external service issues were noted in the evidence.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout in region ap-south rose from 0.53% to 3.54% (+571%), with a change point at 2026-03-26T06:10:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.05).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout in region ap-south stayed about the same (168 per 5 min before, 198 per 5 min after, +18%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout in region ap-south stayed about the same (221 ms before, 220 ms after, -0%).
Deployed checkout v3.17 to ap-south (checkout, ap-south; 2 min before the change; record R010; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
High error rate on checkout in ap-south (checkout, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R011; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) (checkout, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R012; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) (checkout, ap-south; 28 min after the change; record R013; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) (checkout, ap-south; 36 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Rollback the checkout v3.17 deployment to ap-south.
Implement a robust error handling mechanism in the RequestHandler.serialize method.
Monitor the RequestHandler.serialize method for similar issues in future deployments.
